description: Labeled benchmark for ArguMend fallacy detection. Expected sentences must appear verbatim in the case text.
changelog: 1.1.0 — Adjudicated multi-3: imputing a hidden motive ("they really want to hand the budget to their friends") is ad-hominem, not strawman. No case text changed.
1.0.0 — Initial 22-case benchmark (13 fallacy-bearing, 8 clean controls, 1 typography case).

cases.text: Cities should adopt a limited curfew for teenagers under sixteen. A 2023 review of nine municipal programs found that nighttime incidents involving minors fell by 12 percent in the first year, though the authors noted that police staffing also increased during the same period. That evidence is suggestive, not conclusive. A reasonable next step is a one-year pilot in two districts, with an independent evaluation that controls for policing levels.

During the trial, the program reduced reoffending by 8 percent, but the authors warn that the sample was small and the result was not statistically significant. A larger study is needed before the city commits funding.
